snippets.name: reconcile
snippets.source: function reconcile(full,prefix,suffix,history){assert.equal(full.length,2784);assert.deepEqual(history,{original_attempts:332,successful_prefix:331,failed_original_seq:331,failed_target:RETRY_TARGET,original_failure_retained:true,original_failure_has_png:false});assert.equal(prefix.length,331);for(let i=0;i<331;i++){assert.deepEqual(prefix[i].target,full[i],'immutable prefix identity');assert.equal(prefix[i].valid,true,'unverified prefix cannot count');}assert.ok(suffix.length<=2453);for(let i=0;i<suffix.length;i++){assert.deepEqual(suffix[i].target,full[i+331],'suffix skipped/repeated/wrong target');assert.equal(suffix[i].valid,true,'unknown/failed native is not credit');assert.equal(suffix[i].context_complete,true,'missing source/error-stage context cannot count');}return{complete:suffix.length===2453,immutable_completed_prefix:331,new_credited_targets:suffix.length,union_credited_targets:331+suffix.length,expected_union_targets:2784,original_failed_attempt_retained:true,recollected_failed_obligation:suffix.length>0?RETRY_TARGET:null,total_historical_attempts:332+suffix.length,global_ui_pass:false,full_project_approved:false};}

snippets.name: terminalState
snippets.source: function terminalState({domain_complete,new_attempts,credited,completion_present,failure,cleanup=null}){assert.ok(Number.isInteger(new_attempts)&&new_attempts>=0&&new_attempts<=2453);assert.ok(Number.isInteger(credited)&&credited>=0&&credited<=new_attempts);assert.ok(!(completion_present&&failure),'conflicting terminal evidence');const closed=cleanup?.schema===1&&cleanup.attempted===true&&cleanup.native_created===true&&cleanup.closed===true&&cleanup.status==='closed'&&cleanup.error===null;if(completion_present){assert.equal(domain_complete,true);assert.equal(closed,true,'completion without successful immutable native cleanup');}if(failure){assert.equal(failure.captured_new_attempts,new_attempts);assert.equal(failure.automatic_retry,false);assert.equal(failure.original_failure_untouched,true);}const run_complete=domain_complete&&completion_present&&!failure&&closed;return{domain_complete,run_complete,complete:run_complete,run_status:failure?'failed':run_complete?'completed':domain_complete?'domain-complete-awaiting-final-source-and-cleanup':'incomplete',terminal_failure:failure,cleanup,total_historical_attempts:332+new_attempts,new_attempts,failed_obligation_attempted:new_attempts>0,failed_obligation_recollected_validly:credited>0};}
